entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of Toor.
And of that written book.
Which is written in an open parchment.
And by the Bayt Al-Ma'moor (a sacred house in the seventh heaven).
And by the canopy raised high.
And of the blazed sea.
Indeed, your Lord's punishment is definitely to take place.
There is no one to avert it.
On the Day when the heavens will tremble with a dreadful shake.
And the mountains will move speedily.
So, on that Day, destruction is for those who belie (the Prophets).
Those who are playing in idle pastimes.
The Day when they will be pushed forcefully towards the fire of Hell.
(It will be said to them) 'This is the Fire which you used to belie.'
'So, is this magic, or are you unable to see?'
'Enter it (to burn therein), now be patient or impatient, it is all the same for you; you are only being recompensed for what you used to do.'
Indeed, the pious are in Gardens and Bliss.
Delighted of the bestowal from their Lord; and their Lord has saved them from the punishment of the Fire.
'Eat and drink with pleasure; the reward for your (good) deeds.'
Reclining on thrones set in rows; and We have wedded them to Hoors (i.e. maidens of Paradise) having large (gorgeous) eyes.

And those who believed and their children followed them with faith, We have joined their children with them (in Paradise) and have not reduced anything for them from their deeds. Every person (who disbelieves) is trapped in their own doings.
And We helped them with fruit and meat, as they desire.
They receive (therein) cups (of pure wine) from each other in which is neither any immorality nor any sin.
And their serving youth shall go around (serving) them, (they will be beautiful) as if they were pearls, kept (securely) hidden.
And one of them turned towards the other while questioning.
They said, 'Indeed, before this, we were in our houses full of fear.'
'So, Allah did us a great favour and saved us from the punishment of the hot wind (of Hell).'
'Indeed, we worshiped Him in our previous life; indeed, only He is the Bounteous, the Most Merciful.'
Therefore (O Beloved), you advise (them), by the Benevolence of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer nor insane.
Or they allege, 'He is a poet, we await for him some calamity by the turn of time (as happened to previous poets).'
Say you (O Beloved), 'Continue waiting, I too am waiting along with you (for your destruction).'
Is this what their intellects tell them, or are they a rebellious people?
Or they say, 'He (i.e. the Prophet Muhammad) has invented the Qur'aan'? Rather, they do not believe.
So, let them bring a single speech like it, if they are truthful.
Have they not been created from some source, or are they themselves (their own) creators?
Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they have no certainty (about Allah and His Prophet).
Or do they have the treasures of your Lord, or are they a superior authority?
Or do they have any ladder, by climbing upon it they can listen (to the conversations of angels)? So (if it is the case, then) their listener should bring some clear proof.
(Or) are there daughters for Him and sons for you?
Or do you (O Beloved) ask any recompense from them, so they are overburdened with penalty?
Or is (the knowledge of) the unseen with them by which they pass judgement?
Or do they intend some plotting? So, the (evil) plotting is to befall the disbelievers only.
Or do they have another god except Allah? Purity is to Allah from their polytheism.
And if they see a fragment of the sky falling, so they will say, 'It is a heap of clouds.'
Therefore, leave them until they confront their Day, in which they will be unconscious.
A Day on which their conspiracy will not benefit them at all, and nor are they to be helped.
And indeed, for the unjust is another punishment before that, but most of them know not.
And O Beloved, remain firm upon the command of your Lord, that you are indeed in Our Protective Watchful Sight, and proclaim the Purity of your Lord whilst praising Him, when you stand (for Salah).
And proclaim His Purity in a part of the night and at the time when the stars set.
